brief_definition.zh: 在交往中生成的体验性现实。

zh: 这个概念挑战了传统心理学中“孤立心灵”的假设……
en: This concept challenges the traditional assumption of an 'isolated mind'…

example_sentence.zh: 在家庭治疗中，治疗师关注的不仅仅是每个成员各自的问题……
example_sentence.en: In family therapy, the therapist focuses not only on each member’s problems…

caption.zh: 照片来自玛丽娜·阿布拉莫维奇…
caption.en: Photo from Marina Abramović’s 2010 performance 'The Artist is Present' at MoMA…

content.zh: 咨询师和来访者共同在互动中“生成”了那个特定的治疗体验和现实。
content.en: The counselor and the client co-create the specific therapeutic experience and reality.

content.zh: <h3>主体间性这个概念虽然是由西方哲学家提出，但其实我们每一个东方人都更熟悉其中的智慧。<h3>
content.en: <h3>Although intersubjectivity was first introduced by Western philosophers, it is an idea deeply familiar in Eastern traditions.<h3>
